https://nebula.local/schemas/assertion-a.description: F0006 server-computed protected result. F0016 must durably persist outcomes before marking a run complete. This internal result is not an HTTP endpoint or general log payload. No field grants permission.
https://nebula.local/schemas/assertion-a.title: AssertionAdmissionResultV1

https://nebula.local/schemas/assertion-r.description: F0006 design contract, Phase B approved by operator 2026-11-01. Untrusted source claim; structural schema validation does not establish admission, authorization or canonical eligibility.
https://nebula.local/schemas/assertion-r.title: AssertionCandidateV2

https://nebula.local/schemas/canonical-c.description: Proposal for one canonical fact commit (master blueprint section 109.2; F0001-S0005). F0008 design: exactly one of valid_from (legacy pilot slots) or temporal (identity-v1 slots) is present.
https://nebula.local/schemas/canonical-c.title: CanonicalCommitRequest

/properties/temporal.description: F0008 (ADR-0078, Accepted): required for identity-v1 slots (rejected as temporal_fields_required when absent); omitted for legacy pilot slots, which keep valid_from/valid_to semantics. When present, valid_from/valid_to above must be omitted and are derived from this block.

https://nebula.local/schemas/canonical-c.description: Result of a canonical fact commit: the semantic commit id and the fact versions it produced (F0001-S0005). F0008 (S0002 AC7, remediation run 2026-11-18-bce4909b): a fact-temporal/v1 commit adds `versions`, one entry per written version in `fact_version_ids` order, carrying its temporal block; a legacy pilot commit omits it.
https://nebula.local/schemas/canonical-c.title: CanonicalCommitResponse

/properties/versions/items/properties/te.description: Absent for a legacy remainder on an identity-v1 slot.

https://nebula.local/schemas/content-art.description: F0004 proposed v2 parse bundle. Date metadata and interpretation outputs are external, append-only records. Cross-file hashes, identity, duplicate paths and native asset closure require service validation.
https://nebula.local/schemas/content-art.title: ContentArtifactManifestV2

/properties/extraction_quality/propertie.description: F0005-S0001-AC2 (ADR-0073 amendment 2026-10-27): OCR observed during this conversion. Absent or null means not observed (historical producers); never inferred.

https://nebula.local/schemas/content-art.description: Manifest of one accepted parse-once content artifact bundle (master blueprint sections 80, 81, 108.1; F0001-S0003). F0004 compatibility clarification: source.pdf is the observed retained-PDF filename; no v2 metadata is synthesized for legacy artifacts.
https://nebula.local/schemas/content-art.title: ContentArtifactManifest

/properties/extraction_quality/propertie.description: F0005-S0001-AC2 (ADR-0073 amendment 2026-10-27): OCR observed during this conversion. Absent or null means not observed (historical producers); never inferred.

https://nebula.local/schemas/content-rec.description: One JSONL record. Relational uniqueness, bounds, native references and geometry consistency are service checks. Positions refer to exact block.text in Unicode code points; identity normalization never rewrites source text.
https://nebula.local/schemas/content-rec.title: ContentRecordsV2

https://nebula.local/schemas/document-da.description: Append-only candidates and explicit selections; no automatic precedence. HUMAN provenance needs a trusted verifier, not schema validity alone. In v0.1 every selection, including a clear, carries a verified human selection decision; a service principal may record candidates but cannot select. A null candidate explicitly clears the selected date; no selection means undated. YEAR/MONTH/DAY preserve supplied precision.
https://nebula.local/schemas/document-da.title: DocumentDateRecord

/oneOf/1/properties/human_decision.description: Verified human selection decision (F0022 producer). actor_principal_id here is the deciding human; the record's top-level actor_principal_id is the calling principal. Schema validity is not authority: the trusted verifier binds decision, document version, candidate (or clear) and expected previous selection.

https://nebula.local/schemas/fact-answer.description: F0007 answer carrier (ADR-0039 D1-D5, ADR-0077 D5). Stored as the canonical_fact_version.value of an identity-v1 slot; legacy pilot slots keep their unwrapped values. Only PRESENT carries a value. There is no access-denied state: authorization is decided before any answer is produced. Server canonicalization (decimal form, identifier and name normalization) happens before storage.
https://nebula.local/schemas/fact-answer.title: FactAnswerV1

/$defs/absence_scope.description: Exact interpretation scope searched (ADR-0039 D2). Never implies global absence. The artifact must be readable by the caller and owned by the slot's tenant/KB.

/$defs/absence_scope/properties/profile_.description: Pinned ontology-release (or system-predicate registry) reference recorded at creation; never part of slot identity.

https://nebula.local/schemas/fact-slot-k.description: F0007 internal slot-resolution request (ADR-0077). Not an HTTP route. Tenant comes from the authorized scope, never from this payload. Qualifier names are declared by the predicate contract; ordering of the input object is irrelevant to identity.
https://nebula.local/schemas/fact-slot-k.title: FactSlotKeyV1

/$defs/decimal_value.description: Input and canonical value have at most 64 total characters including sign/point. Server semantic validation rejects exponent forms whose canonical expansion exceeds that bound before allocating it; every emitted canonical form is a valid reload input.

/$defs/identifier_value.description: ADR-0039 D5 scoped identifier. normalized_value is server-computed from the identifier-type normalization table; a supplied value that differs is rejected.

/$defs/money_value.description: ADR-0039 D4. Amount is an exact decimal string; a JSON number is rejected (MONEY_FLOAT_REJECTED). Input and canonical amount are bounded to 64 total characters including sign/point; oversized canonical expansions reject DECIMAL_INVALID before allocation. Original currency only in F0007: any conversion marker is rejected (CONVERTED_MONEY_UNSUPPORTED) at the domain validator, so the schema does not admit one.

/$defs/name_value.description: ADR-0066 name value. normalized is server-computed (NFC, casefold, whitespace collapse); evidence must name an admitted F0006 v2 assertion in the slot's tenant/KB.

/$defs/qualifier_value.description: Qualifiers use the scalar typed values only (no name values). Explicit null is rejected with QUALIFIER_NULL_REJECTED; an omitted qualifier contributes nothing to identity.

/properties/member.description: Required to address a member of a MULTI slot; forbidden otherwise.

/properties/object_entity_id.description: Required for RELATIONSHIP predicates, forbidden otherwise.

/properties/predicate_key.description: Opaque namespaced predicate key with its major contract version (ADR-0077 D2). Identity uses the key, not the release reference.

/properties/predicate_release_ref.description: Pinned ontology-release (or system-predicate registry) reference recorded at creation; never part of slot identity.

https://nebula.local/schemas/fact-slot-r.description: F0007 server-computed resolution outcome (ADR-0077). Internal service result, not an HTTP payload. A rejection writes no slot, qualifier or member row. Authorization denial is not an outcome here: the caller receives the facade's non-disclosing denial before any validation detail.
https://nebula.local/schemas/fact-slot-r.title: FactSlotResolutionResultV1

/properties/predicate_key.description: Opaque namespaced predicate key with its major contract version (ADR-0077 D2). Identity uses the key, not the release reference.

https://nebula.local/schemas/fact-tempor.description: F0008 contract (ADR-0078, Accepted): the valid-time block of a canonical commit for identity-v1 slots, and the temporal block returned for a temporal-v1 version. Structural checks only; truncation in zone, attestation derivation from F0004 document-date selections, succession and state guards run in the commit service and database triggers.
https://nebula.local/schemas/fact-tempor.title: FactTemporalV1

/$defs/commit_temporal/properties/attest.description: Zone used to place bounds derived from document dates (an attestation-floor start or an UNKNOWN end).

/$defs/commit_temporal/properties/ending.description: Assertions whose documents state that the fact ended (UNKNOWN end only). attested_to is the earliest selected date among their documents.

/$defs/commit_temporal/properties/expect.description: Optional echo. If present it must equal the server-derived values, otherwise ATTESTATION_MISMATCH.

/$defs/commit_temporal/properties/valid_.description: Known start. Omit or null for an unknown start: the server floors it at attested_from or rejects START_UNATTESTED.

/$defs/document_date.description: An F0004 document-date value at its own precision (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

/$defs/iana_zone.description: IANA time-zone name, for example America/Chicago or the fixed-offset Etc/GMT+6. Existence is validated against the server's zone database, not by this schema.

/$defs/start_basis.description: How the start was obtained. TEMPLATE_FIELD and HUMAN count as grade A (G1 decision 1). ATTESTATION_FLOOR is server-assigned when the start is unknown and is never accepted from a caller.

/$defs/validity_unknown_read/properties/.description: The version whose unknown end or floored start produced the result. No value is returned.

/$defs/version_temporal/properties/valid.description: BOUNDED: the stated end. UNKNOWN: the integrity bound placed at the end of the attested_to period. OPEN: null.
UNKNOWN end only: valid-time reads at or after this instant and before valid_to return validity-unknown.

https://nebula.local/schemas/fact-versio.description: F0011 documents the existing FactVersionOut wire shape (flat timestamps), including the F0008 additive metadata. It changes no runtime response. Legacy pilot values remain unwrapped; temporal is omitted for legacy versions.
https://nebula.local/schemas/fact-versio.title: FactVersionReadV1

https://nebula.local/schemas/information.description: F0011 publication alias for the shipped definition. This adds no field, normalization rule or domain acceptance. ADR-0079 design; implementation proof pending.
https://nebula.local/schemas/information.title: InformationStateV1

https://nebula.local/schemas/interpretat.description: Run-owned outputs stay outside the parse bundle. V1 reflects the existing checkpoint marker; proposed v2 adds pipeline identity and exact date-basis selection. The selected output schema is independent of content artifact version.
https://nebula.local/schemas/interpretat.title: InterpretationOutputManifest

https://nebula.local/schemas/interpretat.description: F0006 additive result version. No live producer is activated; the existing importer continues to accept only legacy v1. Candidate entities are document-local references, never canonical entities. Complete items may be checked independently; F0016 owns durable drops and run lifecycle.
https://nebula.local/schemas/interpretat.title: InterpretationResultV2

https://nebula.local/schemas/interpretat.description: Provider-neutral output of one semantic interpretation run over a persisted content artifact (master blueprint section 108.3; F0001-S0003).
https://nebula.local/schemas/interpretat.title: InterpretationResult

https://nebula.local/schemas/problem-det.description: RFC 9457 problem details with a stable machine `code` and a `traceId` extension member (camelCase to match the framework API contract validator; every other payload is snake_case). F0001-S0001.
https://nebula.local/schemas/problem-det.title: ProblemDetails

https://nebula.local/schemas/qualified-m.description: F0011 publication alias for the shipped definition. This adds no field, normalization rule or domain acceptance. ADR-0079 design; implementation proof pending.
https://nebula.local/schemas/qualified-m.title: QualifiedMoneyV1

https://nebula.local/schemas/scoped-iden.description: F0011 publication alias for the shipped definition. This adds no field, normalization rule or domain acceptance. ADR-0079 design; implementation proof pending.
